newsitem.title: UK: Sterling hovers below $1.66 in Europe as dlr firm.
newsitem.headline: Sterling hovers below $1.66 in Europe as dlr firm.

text.p: 0827 GMT - Sterling hovers below $1.66 after U.S. unit burst to 7-1/2 year highs vs mark and jumped to highest since Aug 1993 against Swiss franc, though now off highs against both.

* Sterling/mark touch weaker, but holding around 3.0510 support. Stg/mark at 3.0536/46 vs 3.0560/70 in late Europe on Friday. Cable at $1.6557/68 vs $1.6616/26 in late Europe and early highs of $1.6660.
* CBI says new export orders for Britain's small- and medium-sized firms fell at their fastest rate in six years over the last four months.
* Bank of England's Monetary Policy Committee due to meet on August 6 and 7 and there is speculation this could result in the fourth UK rate rise in as many months.
